# 3. Processing classes and cleaned tibble
```{r}
general_classes <- sub(" .*", "", classes)
non_NA <- names(classes)[classes != "NA"]

SENTINEL <- -999

cleaned_data <- lapply(non_NA, FUN = function(column) {
  complete_class <- str_split_1(classes[column], " ")
  root_class <- complete_class[1]
  codes <- complete_class[-1]

  valid_skip_codes <- as.numeric(codes[grepl("6$", codes)])    # question didn't apply -> NA
  nonresponse_codes <- as.numeric(codes[!grepl("6$", codes)])  # true missing -> SENTINEL (to do computations with)

  v <- pumf[[column]]
  v[v %in% nonresponse_codes] <- SENTINEL
  v[v %in% valid_skip_codes]  <- NA

  if (root_class %in% c("YN", "YNDK")) {
    keep <- !is.na(v) & v != SENTINEL
    v[keep & v == 2] <- 0
    if (root_class == "YNDK") {
      v[keep & v == 3] <- 2  
    }
  }
  v   # everything stays numeric for now; factors are made after imputation
}) |>
  setNames(non_NA) |>
  as_tibble()

numeric_classes <- names(general_classes)[general_classes %in% c("Ord", "YN", "YNC", "Num")]
```

# 4. Do imputations
```{r}
num_vars <- c("LSM_01", "PAADVVOL", "PAA_15A", "LBFDGHPW")
cat_vars <- c("GEN_05", "GEN_01", "GEN_10", "INCDGHH", "EDDVH3", "FSCDVHF2", "DHH_SEX")

analysis_data <- cleaned_data %>% select(all_of(c(num_vars, cat_vars)))

# 1. How much true missingness is there, vs. valid skips?
tibble(
  variable      = names(analysis_data),
  true_missing  = sapply(analysis_data, function(x) sum(x %in% SENTINEL)),
  valid_skip_NA = sapply(analysis_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
)

# 2. Fill only the sentinel cells; valid-skip NAs are left alone
impute_true_missing <- function(x, how = c("mean", "median")) {
  how <- match.arg(how)
  is_true <- !is.na(x) & x == SENTINEL
  observed <- x[!is.na(x) & x != SENTINEL]
  fill <- if (how == "mean") mean(observed) else quantile(observed, 0.5, type = 1, names = FALSE)
  x[is_true] <- fill
  x
}

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_vars), ~ impute_true_missing(.x, "mean")),
         across(all_of(cat_vars), ~ impute_true_missing(.x, "median"))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cat_vars), factor))

cat("any sentinels left:", any(sapply(analysis_data, function(x) any(x %in% SENTINEL))), "\n")

# drop nas
analysis_data <- drop_na(analysis_data)
```

# 6. Multiple Linear Regression Model with Interaction
```{r}
model <- lm(
  LSM_01 ~ PAADVVOL * GEN_05 + PAA_15A + LBFDGHPW + GEN_01 + GEN_10 + INCDGHH + EDDVH3 + FSCDVHF2 + DHH_SEX,
  data = analysis_data
)
```

# 7. Summary

```{r}
summary(model)
```

# 8. Residual and QQ Plots 
```{r}
png("resid_qq.png", width = 1000, height = 1000, res = 120)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(model, which = 1)
plot(model, which = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

dev.off()
```

# 9. Pairwise Plots for Predictors
```{r}
png("pairs.png", width = 1000, height = 1000, res = 120)

analysis_data %>%
  select(LSM_01, PAADVVOL, LBFDGHPW, GEN_05, GEN_01, GEN_10) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  slice_sample(n = 2000) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  pairs(pch = 19, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.2),
        main = "Pairwise Relationships of Selected Variables")

dev.off()
```
